steps.script: (() => { const el=[...document.querySelectorAll('td, th, div, span')].find(e => e.childElementCount===0 && e.textContent.trim().toLowerCase()==='planning'); if (el) { el.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); let p=el.parentElement; while (p && p.scrollHeight<=p.clientHeight) p=p.parentElement; if (p) p.scrollTop -= 60; } })()

notes: Rows are sorted alphabetically by the client; the evaluate step scrolls the 'Planning' row to the top so the Planning - ... rows fill the table, including 'Planning - Global Filters' (outlined). The prepopulate roles have no privileges ticked (admin is an administrator user type and needs none).
